hints: Notice the square root: square both sides to get $v^2 = \gamma P / \rho$, then rearrange to $\gamma = v^2 \rho / P$.
Write each quantity in SI base units: $v$ in $\text{m s}^{-1}$, $\rho$ in $\text{kg m}^{-3}$ and pressure $P = F/A$ in $\text{kg m}^{-1} \text{s}^{-2}$.
Multiply out the units of $v^2 \rho$ and compare them with the units of $P$ to see what units $\gamma$ must supply for homogeneity.
walkthrough: Square the given equation to remove the root: $v^2 = \gamma P / \rho$, so $\gamma = v^2 \rho / P$.
State base units: $[v] = \text{m s}^{-1}$, so $[v^2] = \text{m}^2 \text{s}^{-2}$, and $[\rho] = \text{kg m}^{-3}$.
State base units of pressure from $P = F/A$: force is $\text{kg m s}^{-2}$ divided by area $\text{m}^2$, so $[P] = \text{kg m}^{-1} \text{s}^{-2}$.
Substitute units into the expression for $\gamma$: $[\gamma] = (\text{m}^2 \text{s}^{-2})(\text{kg m}^{-3}) / (\text{kg m}^{-1} \text{s}^{-2})$.
Simplify: numerator is $\text{kg m}^{-1} \text{s}^{-2}$, which is exactly the denominator, so all $\text{kg}$, $\text{m}$ and $\text{s}$ cancel.
Therefore $\gamma$ has no units and is dimensionless. This is option D.

options.A: This would leave the right-hand side with units of speed only if $P/\rho$ had different units, but $P/\rho$ already has units of $v^2$.
options.B: This suggests $\gamma$ carries length and time units to balance the equation, but the base units of $v^2 \rho / P$ cancel completely.
options.C: This has both negative powers of $\text{m}$ and $\text{s}$, which would not make $\gamma P/\rho$ have the units of $v^2$.
options.D: Rearranging gives $\gamma = v^2 \rho / P$ and the units of $v^2 \rho$ are identical to the units of $P$, so $\gamma$ is dimensionless.
